name: Zev
self_text: I've always loved the precision of baking sourdough, which carries over into my gaming. These days it's all Tidewatch for me on console, where I'm mostly into ranked matches. I usually end up in a flexible role as I can fill any position. I'm on text chat or voice chat and am available most weeks on Sunday afternoon or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I'm searching for a gaming partner, and you have to be into Tidewatch. It would also be a small bonus if you are into ranked matches, but no big deal.
I need you to be into Tidewatch. It would be a small bonus if you are into casual matches; this is a change from my usual preference for ranked matches, but it's no big deal.
